answer: Agents reporting a zephyr through a walnut orchard could post a bond for each active identity. A random audit pulse asks for measurements that independent sensors can check; proven fabrication burns the bond. Lock bonds until late audits finish, so an attacker cannot reuse the same capital across disposable names. Size the bond so audit probability times the loss exceeds the maximum fraud payout. Extra identities then tie up proportional capital and increase expected losses rather than free rewards.
